<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="uz">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>UnLag</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik:wght@700;800;900&display=swap">
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg1:#070e0c;--bg2:#0f1815;--green:#22e06b;--orange:#ff6a00;--ink:#ebfff0;box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg1:#070e0c;--bg2:#0f1815;--ink:#ebfff0}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg1:#070e0c;--bg2:#0f1815;--ink:#ebfff0}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
body{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--bg1),var(--bg2));color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;
  font-family:'Rubik','Verdana','DejaVu Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800}
.stage{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 6px)}
.floaters{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.floaters img{position:absolute;left:0;opacity:.5;will-change:transform;
  animation:fly var(--dur) linear infinite;animation-delay:var(--delay)}
.block{position:absolute;left:0;opacity:.7;will-change:transform;
  animation:fly var(--dur) linear infinite;animation-delay:var(--delay)}
@keyframes fly{
  0%{transform:translate(-26vw,0) rotate(var(--r0))}
  100%{transform:translate(116vw,var(--dy)) rotate(var(--r1))}}
.content{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding:0 5vw}
.content::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-12% -8%;z-index:-1;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(6,12,10,.82),rgba(6,12,10,0) 70%)}
.glitch{position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:inline-block;color:var(--green);
  font-weight:900;font-size:min(22vw,34vh);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0}
.glitch::before,.glitch::after{content:attr(data-text);position:absolute;inset:0}
.glitch::before{color:var(--orange);transform:translate(.045em,.04em);z-index:-1;animation:jitter 4s infinite steps(1)}
.glitch::after{color:var(--green);clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);animation:slice 3.2s infinite steps(1)}
@keyframes slice{
  0%,100%{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transform:none}
  6%{clip-path:inset(18% 0 58% 0);transform:translateX(-.07em)}
  9%{clip-path:inset(62% 0 14% 0);transform:translateX(.08em)}
  12%{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transform:none}
  58%{clip-path:inset(40% 0 40% 0);transform:translateX(.06em)}
  61%{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transform:none}}
@keyframes jitter{
  0%,100%{transform:translate(.045em,.04em)}
  7%{transform:translate(.1em,.02em)}
  10%{transform:translate(.03em,.06em)}
  13%{transform:translate(.045em,.04em)}}
.tag{margin:.4em 0 0;font-size:min(4.6vw,7vh);color:var(--ink);text-shadow:.07em .05em 0 var(--orange)}
.promo{margin:1.1em 0 0;font-size:min(3.1vw,4.6vh);font-weight:700;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.promo b{display:inline-block;background:var(--orange);color:#0a0e0c;font-weight:900;padding:.05em .45em;
  border-radius:.3em;box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(255,106,0,.45);animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{box-shadow:0 0 42px rgba(255,106,0,.8)}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="stage">
  <div class="floaters" id="floaters"></div>
  <div class="content">
    <h1 class="glitch" data-text="UnLag">UnLag</h1>
    <p class="tag">qotish bahona emas</p>
    <p class="promo"><b>AXADIO</b> promokodi orqali 20% chegirmaga ega bo’ling<br>hamda serverlarda qotishlarsiz o’ynang</p>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
const LOGOS=[{n:"pubg",src:"data:image/png;base64,",w:1.3},{n:"codm",src:"data:image/png;base64,",w:0.8},{n:"cs",src:"data:image/png;base64,",w:0.9},{n:"ff",src:"data:image/png;base64,",w:2.6},{n:"mlbb",src:"data:image/png;base64,",w:2.6}];
const box=document.getElementById('floaters');
const slots=[[4,8],[22,68],[40,6],[60,72],[78,10],[86,58],[12,40],[48,80],[68,34],[30,30]];
const rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
slots.forEach((s,i)=>{
  const L=LOGOS[i%LOGOS.length];
  const img=document.createElement('img');
  img.src=L.src;img.alt='';
  img.style.width=(8*L.w)+'vw';img.style.maxWidth=(190*L.w)+'px';
  img.style.top=s[1]+'%';
  const st=img.style,d=rnd(16,28);
  st.setProperty('--sx',s[0]+'%');
  st.setProperty('--dy',rnd(-8,8)+'vh');
  st.setProperty('--r0',rnd(-10,-2)+'deg');st.setProperty('--r1',rnd(2,10)+'deg');
  st.setProperty('--dur',d+'s');st.setProperty('--delay',(-rnd(0,d))+'s');
  box.appendChild(img);
});
for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
  const b=document.createElement('div');b.className='block';
  const sz=rnd(8,22);
  const bd=rnd(9,16);
  b.style.cssText='width:'+sz+'px;height:'+sz+'px;top:'+rnd(4,92)+'%;background:'+(i%2?'#22e06b':'#ff6a00');
  b.style.setProperty('--sx',rnd(2,96)+'%');
  b.style.setProperty('--dy',rnd(-6,6)+'vh');
  b.style.setProperty('--r0','0deg');b.style.setProperty('--r1',rnd(-90,90)+'deg');
  b.style.setProperty('--dur',bd+'s');b.style.setProperty('--delay',(-rnd(0,bd))+'s');
  box.appendChild(b);
}
const items=[...box.children].map(el=>{const g=k=>parseFloat(el.style.getPropertyValue(k));
  return{el,dur:g('--dur'),p0:-g('--delay')/g('--dur'),dy:g('--dy'),r0:g('--r0'),r1:g('--r1')};});
items.forEach(o=>{o.el.style.animation='none'});
const t0=performance.now();
function tick(now){
  const W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
  items.forEach(o=>{
    const t=(((now-t0)/1000)/o.dur+o.p0)%1;
    o.el.style.transform='translate('+(-0.26*W+t*1.42*W)+'px,'+(t*o.dy*H/100)+'px) rotate('+(o.r0+t*(o.r1-o.r0))+'deg)';
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
requestAnimationFrame(tick);
</script>
</body>
</html>
